inputs.text: No-notice internal drill message played by phone to the State Warning Point. The FCC report says it contained the text of an EAS message for a live ballistic missile alert, including "this is not a drill", and the words "Exercise, Exercise, Exercise" at the beginning and end.

requested_area.areaDesc: State of Hawaii (internal drill; no public area was intended)

fields.description: EXERCISE EXERCISE EXERCISE. Internal HI-EMA State Warning Point drill simulating a ballistic missile alert for the State of Hawaii. There is NO real threat. Staff drill only. EXERCISE EXERCISE EXERCISE.
fields.headline: EXERCISE EXERCISE EXERCISE - Internal State Warning Point drill - no real threat
fields.instruction: This is a drill for State Warning Point staff only. Do not send to the public and take no protective action.
left_out: The live EAS ballistic missile alert text in input 1 was left out, including the phrase 'this is not a drill'. It is verified, but it contradicts the Exercise status and could be taken as a real missile warning if it reached the public.
fields.note_for_reviewer: This must NOT go out by cell broadcast, EAS or WEA: the operator's area is the whole State of Hawaii, but the context says no public area was intended. The drill script mixing 'Exercise' with live 'this is not a drill' text matches the cause of the 2018 false missile alert. Urgency, severity and certainty are set to Unknown because no real hazard exists.
